{"question": "What was Warsaw the most diverse of in Poland?", "sources": [{"source_id": "squad-context-c206679cc4afbecc5d61f9d8ed6a31b94b426372acc9d19298e47a403405d9de", "text": "Demographically, it was the most diverse city in Poland, with significant numbers of foreign-born inhabitants.
